comparator_config.decision_rule: Flagged if any default Evidently test returns status FAIL
comparator_config.description: Runs Report([DataDriftPreset()], include_tests=True) on candidate vs reference training data and Report([ClassificationPreset()], include_tests=True) on candidate vs champion test predictions with 100% Evidently default thresholds; flagged if any test returns FAIL.

feature_leakage.description: Add a column derived from the target

label_shift.description: Corrupt labels in one subgroup of the train set

degraded_slice.description: Remove most of one subgroup from training data

schema_drift.description: Change a column's scale or unit

latency_regression.description: Swap in a much larger model

fairness_regression.description: Bias sampling against one protected group

noop.description: Retrain with a different seed (should PASS)
